events.title: The Pilot
events.description: Rachel Green flees her wedding and moves in with Monica Geller. Ross is depressed over his divorce from Carol.

events.title: The One with the East German Laundry Detergent
events.description: Ross and Rachel have their first unofficial 'date' while doing laundry together.

events.title: The One Where Nana Dies Twice
events.description: The Geller family deals with the passing of Nana, who briefly 'wakes up' after being declared dead.

events.title: The One with the Monkey
events.description: Ross adopts Marcel, a capuchin monkey, to combat his loneliness.

events.title: The One with the Stoned Guy
events.description: Jon Lovitz guest stars as a restaurateur who shows up high to an interview with Monica.

events.title: The One with All the Poker
events.description: The girls learn to play poker to beat the guys; Rachel loses to Ross but he lets her win.

events.title: The One with the Birth
events.description: Ross's son, Ben Geller, is born. Susan and Ross argue over the middle name.

events.title: The One Where Rachel Finds Out
events.description: Rachel learns that Ross is in love with her while he is away in China for a paleontology dig.

events.title: The One with Ross's New Girlfriend
events.description: Ross returns from China with Julie, devastating Rachel who was waiting for him at the airport.

events.title: The One Where Ross Finds Out
events.description: Ross and Rachel share their first real kiss in the rain outside Central Perk.

events.title: The One After the Superbowl
events.description: The highest-rated episode of the series, featuring guest stars Julia Roberts and Jean-Claude Van Damme.

events.title: The One with the Prom Video
events.description: Rachel sees an old video of Ross offering to take her to prom and finally forgives him. 'He's her lobster!'

events.title: The One Where Joey Moves Out
events.description: Following his success on 'Days of Our Lives,' Joey moves into his own luxury apartment.

events.title: The One Where Dr. Ramoray Dies
events.description: Joey is killed off 'Days of Our Lives' by falling down an elevator shaft after angering the writers.

events.title: The One with Barry and Mindy's Wedding
events.description: Rachel serves as maid of honor for her ex-fiancé and sings 'Copacabana' to save face.

events.title: The One with the Princess Leia Fantasy
events.description: Season 3 premieres with Ross revealing his geeky fantasy to Rachel.

events.title: The One with the Flashback
events.description: Janice asks the group if any of them have ever slept together, leading to a series of near-miss flashbacks.

events.title: The One with the Football
events.description: The Gellers compete for the 'Geller Cup' in a Thanksgiving touch football game.

events.title: The One Where Rachel Quits
events.description: Rachel finally quits her job as a waitress at Central Perk to pursue a career in fashion.

events.title: The One Where Ross and Rachel Take a Break
events.description: Ross sleeps with Chloe, the copy girl, after he and Rachel decide to 'take a break' during their anniversary.

events.title: The One with the Morning After
events.description: Rachel finds out about Ross's infidelity, leading to their first official breakup.

events.title: The One with the Tiny T-Shirt
events.description: Ross struggles to move on from Rachel as she begins dating Mark from Bloomingdale's.

events.title: The One at the Beach
events.description: The group travels to a beach house where Bonnie shaves her head and Rachel reveals she still loves Ross.

events.title: The One with the Jellyfish
events.description: Monica is stung by a jellyfish, leading to a legendary story involving Chandler and Joey.

events.title: The One with the Dirty Girl
events.description: Ross dates a beautiful scientist (Rebecca Romijn) whose apartment is a disaster zone.

events.title: The One with Phoebe's Uterus
events.description: Phoebe agrees to be a surrogate for her half-brother Frank Jr. and his wife Alice.

events.title: The One with the Embryos
events.description: The guys win Monica and Rachel's apartment in a trivia contest. Phoebe is successfully implanted with embryos.

events.title: The One with the Fake Party
events.description: Rachel throws a 'fake party' for Emily just to spend time with her crush, Joshua.

events.title: The One with All the Haste
events.description: Monica and Rachel switch apartments back with the guys after a high-stakes bet.

events.title: The One with Ross's Wedding
events.description: In London, Ross says 'Rachel' at the altar. Monica and Chandler sleep together for the first time.

events.title: The One After Ross Says Rachel
events.description: Season 5 begins with the fallout of Ross's wedding disaster and the start of Monica and Chandler's secret romance.

events.title: The One Hundredth
events.description: Phoebe gives birth to triplets: Frank Jr. Jr., Leslie, and Chandler.

events.title: The One with All the Thanksgivings
events.description: The group shares their worst Thanksgiving memories; Monica puts a turkey on her head.

events.title: The One with All the Resolutions
events.description: Ross's resolution to try something new every day leads to a disaster with leather pants.

events.title: The One Where Everybody Finds Out
events.description: Phoebe and Rachel 'mess' with Monica and Chandler after learning their secret. 'They don't know we know they know we know!'

events.title: The One with the Cop
events.description: Ross buys a new couch and repeatedly yells 'PIVOT!' as he, Rachel, and Chandler try to carry it upstairs.

events.title: The One in Vegas
events.description: Monica and Chandler almost marry in Vegas, only to see a drunken Ross and Rachel emerge from a chapel married.

events.title: The One After Vegas
events.description: Ross and Rachel realize they are married. Ross tries to avoid a third divorce.

events.title: The One with Ross's Denial
events.description: Rachel officially moves out of Monica's apartment to give Monica and Chandler space to live together.

events.title: The One with Joey's Porsche
events.description: Joey finds a set of Porsche keys and pretends to own the car to get attention.

events.title: The One Where Ross Got High
events.description: Rachel makes a 'trifle' that contains beef and peas. The Gellers find out Chandler and Monica are living together.

events.title: The One with the Routine
events.description: Monica and Ross perform their high school dance routine on 'Dick Clark's New Year's Rockin' Eve.'

events.title: The One with the Unagi
events.description: Ross tries to teach Rachel and Phoebe about the state of total awareness known as 'Unagi.'

events.title: The One That Could Have Been
events.description: A two-part episode imagining how the friends' lives would be different if they had made different choices.

events.title: The One with the Ring
events.description: Chandler and Phoebe go shopping for an engagement ring for Monica.

events.title: The One with the Proposal
events.description: After a series of complications involving Richard, Chandler proposes to Monica in a candlelit apartment.

events.title: The One with Monica's Thunder
events.description: Monica is upset when Ross and Rachel's kiss steals the spotlight from her engagement celebration.

events.title: The One Where Chandler Doesn't Like Dogs
events.description: Chandler reveals his secret fear of dogs. Rachel invites her assistant Tag to Thanksgiving.

events.title: The One with the Holiday Armadillo
events.description: Ross dresses as the 'Holiday Armadillo' to teach Ben about Hanukkah.

events.title: The One Where They're Up All Night
events.description: The group spends a sleepless night on a roof, in a car, and in various other awkward situations.

events.title: The One Where Rosita Dies
events.description: Joey's beloved recliner, Rosita, is accidentally broken, leading to a comedic cover-up.

events.title: The One with Rachel's Big Kiss
events.description: Rachel's old college friend (Winona Ryder) visits, and they reminisce about a drunken kiss.

events.title: The One with Monica and Chandler's Wedding
events.description: Monica and Chandler marry. Phoebe finds a positive pregnancy test and assumes it's Monica's.

events.title: The One After 'I Do'
events.description: Rachel reveals to Phoebe and Monica that she is the one who is pregnant.

events.title: The One with the Red Sweater
events.description: The father of Rachel's baby is revealed to be Ross after Phoebe finds his red sweater.

events.title: The One with the Halloween Party
events.description: Sean Penn guest stars at a Halloween party where Ross dresses as 'Spud-nik.'

events.title: The One with the Rumor
events.description: Brad Pitt guest stars as a former high school classmate who co-founded the 'I Hate Rachel Green' club.

events.title: The One Where Joey Dates Rachel
events.description: Joey takes Rachel on a 'date' to cheer her up and realizes he is actually falling in love with her.

events.title: The One with the Birthing Video
events.description: Mona finds out Rachel is living with Ross. Chandler accidentally watches a graphic birthing video.

events.title: The One with Joey's Interview
events.description: Joey prepares for an interview with Soap Opera Digest with the help of the group.

events.title: The One Where Rachel Has a Baby
events.description: Rachel gives birth to Emma Geller-Greene. Joey accidentally 'proposes' to Rachel.

events.title: The One Where No One Proposes
events.description: Ross and Rachel deal with the misunderstanding of Joey's accidental proposal.

events.title: The One with Phoebe's Birthday Dinner
events.description: Only Phoebe and Joey show up on time for her birthday dinner as the others are delayed by drama.

events.title: The One with Rachel's Other Sister
events.description: Christina Applegate guest stars as Rachel's self-centered sister, Amy, at Thanksgiving.

events.title: The One with Phoebe's Rats
events.description: Phoebe's pet rat has babies, and she insists on keeping them, much to Mike's dismay.

events.title: The One with the Mugging
events.description: Phoebe realizes she once mugged Ross when they were teenagers.

events.title: The One with the Memorial Service
events.description: Ross posts a fake obituary for himself on his college alumni site to see who will attend his memorial.

events.title: The One in Barbados
events.description: In Barbados, Charlie breaks up with Joey for Ross, and Rachel and Joey finally kiss.

events.title: The One After Joey and Rachel Kiss
events.description: Season 10 begins with the group navigating the new romantic dynamics from the Barbados trip.

events.title: The One Where Ross Is Fine
events.description: Ross tries to prove he is 'fine' with Joey and Rachel's relationship by hosting a disastrous fajita dinner.

events.title: The One with the Late Thanksgiving
events.description: Monica and Chandler get the news that a birth mother has chosen them to adopt her baby.

events.title: The One with the Home Study
events.description: A social worker visits Monica and Chandler. Danny DeVito guest stars as a stripper for Phoebe's bachelorette party.

events.title: The One with Phoebe's Wedding
events.description: Phoebe and Mike marry in a beautiful outdoor ceremony during a New York City blizzard.

events.title: The One Where Joey Speaks French
events.description: Phoebe tries to teach Joey French for an audition, but he only speaks gibberish.

events.title: The One with Princess Consuela
events.description: Phoebe legally changes her name to Princess Consuela Banana Hammock. Mike changes his to Crap Bag.

events.title: The One with Rachel's Going Away Party
events.description: The group throws a party for Rachel before her move to Paris. She and Ross spend one last night together.

events.title: The Last One
events.description: The series finale. Rachel 'gets off the plane' for Ross. Monica and Chandler bring home twins. The six friends leave their keys.

events.title: Joey Spin-off Premieres
events.description: Following the series finale of Friends, Matt LeBlanc returns as Joey Tribbiani in his own spin-off series.

events.title: Friends: The Reunion
events.description: The cast returns to the original soundstage for an unscripted special to reminisce about the show.
